title: みんなの人気者の後に・ド根性！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara is on a losing streak, but that doesn't slow her down. Because of this, people have started to call her "the Umamusume who never gives up!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Among them are people in her fan club. Meeting them boosts Haru Urara's spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her fiery motivation, I am determined to find a specific race for Haru Urara to set her sights on. Once she has that, I'll do whatever it takes to help her win.
